# Together controller libraries

These seven GLB/JSON pairs are copied unchanged from
https://github.com/hmlim123/hellokitty3D/tree/e38cb3686e11a7fd1dd37f6ad9e3773e84a2fc92/together_motions .
Each JSON records its editable Blender source checksum, clip ranges, normalization,
measured palm contacts and occupied-paw grip coordinates. Original character
meshes are reused. Editing instructions and geometry proofs live with the sources.
